key_differences_from_mt103_pacs008.details: MT202/pacs.009 is institution-to-institution. No field 50 (ordering customer) or 59 (beneficiary customer). Only fields 52/58 (institutions).
MT202 has no field 71A (details of charges). Charges are settled separately between institutions.
MT202 has no field 70 (remittance info). This is bank-to-bank cover, underlying customer details are in the related MT103 (field 21 reference).
MT202 is simpler - mainly routing information (52/53/54/56/57/58) and settlement details (32A).

round_trip_notes: MT->MX->MT preserves all interbank transfer details. MX->MT->MX loses creation timestamp. Field 21 related reference is important for linking to underlying customer payment (MT103). If MX pacs.009 contains batch (multiple CdtTrfTxInf), only first transaction can be translated to MT202.

validation_notes.mt_validation: Valid MT202 with all routing fields. Field 21 relates to underlying customer payment. Field 72 provides instructions for processing.
validation_notes.mx_validation: Valid pacs.009 with instructing/instructed agents, intermediaries, creditor, and creditor agent. All mandatory elements present.
